categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Labeled P2P and modifies orphan handling and package construction in src/node/txdownloadman_impl.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes an edge case where orphans admitted to the mempool via RPC remain in the orphanage and trigger an Assume(false) assertion failure during 1P1C package evaluation. Reviewers verified the reproduction on master and confirmed this patch prevents the assertion violation.
